## v2.2.4

### Fixed and improved

- Improved first-message delivery when a handheld needs to discover the sender before receiving an attachment.
- Improved discovery over LoRa and other interfaces, reducing the need for manual announces.
- Replaced peer-list pages with a continuous list and kept selection stable as peers update.
- Prevented brief status-refresh failures from replacing or duplicating message delivery labels. A separate retry action appears only after persistent failures.

### Build and compatibility

- Handheld firmware remains in beta. Cardputer requires a Cap LoRa-1262 with an antenna for LoRa.
- Factory ZIP installations erase settings, identity, and internal message history. Back up anything you want to keep before installing.
